title: Model data-handling record
description: One sourced, dated claim about how a specific model, on a specific host/access path, handles inference data. Powers the trade-off explainer. A record is a per-(model, host, condition) posture, not a per-host verdict.

provider.description: Model provider, e.g. anthropic, openai, meta, mistral.

model.description: Model id or family. '*' means all models from this provider on this host under this condition.

host.description: Where inference runs / how it is accessed.

is_default.description: True if this posture applies with no special setting. False if 'condition' must be met to reach it.

condition.description: The setting, flag, plan, or opt-in that this posture depends on, e.g. 'provider_data_share enabled'. Null if unconditional.

provider_access.description: Does the MODEL PROVIDER (not the host) receive the inference data.

stays_in_host_boundary.description: True if data stays within the accessing party's trust boundary (e.g. the customer's cloud account) and is not routed to the provider.

retained.description: Whether inference data is retained beyond the request by the host or provider.

retention_days.description: Retention window in days. 0 = ephemeral / not retained. Null = unknown or not disclosed.

used_for_training.description: Whether inference data trains models by default. 'opt-out' = used unless the user disables; 'opt-in' = not used unless the user enables.

capability_note.description: Honest note on capability trade-off of choosing this path (e.g. 'local model ~70% of frontier on coding tasks'). The explainer must state the downside, not only the privacy benefit.

confidence.description: Evidence tier. vendor-doc = primary vendor documentation; reported = credible third party; inferred = our reasoning. Mirrors the project's observed/reported/inferred discipline.

verified_date.description: Date this record was last checked against its sources. Records older than a review interval are shown as stale.
